title: About BSDC
introBody: BSDC exists because Bangladeshi developers were scattered across a dozen groups, pages and chat apps. This platform puts the community back in one place that the community can actually own.
ownershipBody: BSDC is a platform of RRC Development. RRC Development owns the platform, funds it and is accountable for it.

roadmap.title: Public roadmap
roadmap.body: What is planned, what is shipped and what slipped is published.

moderation.title: Open rules
moderation.body: Community rules, enforcement and appeals are documented and versioned.

data.title: Honest data handling
data.body: What we collect, why we collect it and how long we keep it is stated in plain language.

money.title: Clear money flows
money.body: Fees, payouts and refunds are shown before you commit to anything.

contactBody: Write to us for partnerships, press, moderation appeals or accessibility issues.
legalBody: The BSDC source is public for transparency. It is not open for re-deployment or rebranding: copying the platform to run it under another name is not permitted.
